title: 2013 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: A basketball team’s players were successful on \(50\%\) of their two-point shots and \(40\%\) of their three-point shots, which resulted in \(54\) points. They attempted \(50\%\) more two-point shots than three-point shots. How many three-point shots did they attempt?

solutions.text:
Let \(t\) be the number of three-point attempts.

The number of made three-point shots is \(0.4 t,\) giving \(1.2t\) points.

The number of two-point attempts is \(1.5t,\) so the number made is \(0.75t,\) giving \(1.5t\) points.

Thus the total number of points satisfies \[2.7t=54,\] so \(t=20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Let \(x\) be the number of three-point attempts
